name: producer-guest
description: Origin-relative guest pages served by the self-hosted Producer server. Built output is committed to ../public/guest so `wrangler deploy` needs no build step.
//: No node_modules here on purpose. react, react-dom, vite and @vitejs/plugin-react resolve from the repository root's node_modules (Node walks up parent directories). Run `npm install` at the REPO ROOT, never here.
